current.meaning: Source current or current-step magnitude under the declared baseline; not an isolated ion flux.

applied_voltage.meaning: Source applied voltage under its retained sign convention.

reversal_voltage.meaning: Source reversal voltage under its own retained ionic conditions.

reported_conductance.meaning: Conductance reported by the source, separate from the defined chord calculation.

absolute_driving_voltage.meaning: Magnitude of applied minus applicable reversal voltage; the chord denominator.

chord_conductance.meaning: Current magnitude divided by driving-voltage magnitude under supported condition applicability; not differential conductance.

charge_equivalent_rate.meaning: Magnitude of electrical charge flow in elementary-charge equivalents per second; not ion identity, pore count or molecular turnover.

chord_conductance_variance.meaning: Conditional first-order variance of the defined chord from the supplied full primitive covariance.

chord_conductance_standard_uncertainty.meaning: Square root of conditional first-order chord variance; no confidence level is implied.
